segments.ja363:1.1: Hiriṃ tarantaṃ vijigucchamānaṃ, tavāhamasmī iti bhāsamānaṃ;
segments.ja363:1.3: Seyyāni kammāni anādiyantaṃ, neso mamanti iti naṃ vijaññā.
segments.ja363:2.1: Yañhi kayirā tañhi vade, yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade;
segments.ja363:3.1: Na so mitto yo sadā appamatto, bhedāsaṅkī randhamevānupassī;
segments.ja363:3.3: Yasmiñca setī urasīva putto, sa ve mitto yo abhejjo parehi.
